sources.source: Apple App Store public reviews for UnfollowPeek (US/CZ)
sources.summary: One reviewer reports imported relationship results did not match their understanding; a separate review reports false-positive unfollowers. Developer responses point to export completeness and changed export structure as possible causes.
sources.limitations: Competitor-specific anecdotal reviews; no verified diagnosis, no population prevalence, no identity/handle retained.

sources.source: Apple App Store public version history for UnfollowPeek
sources.summary: Release notes describe export-format changes, import errors, duplicate rows, and a failure mode that could incorrectly show everyone following back.
sources.limitations: Developer-authored change log, not independent user validation or evidence of Peekly defects.

sources.source: r/Instagram public thread about checking who does not follow back
sources.summary: A public discussion describes using an Instagram data export and spreadsheet comparison as a workaround, alongside concern about giving credentials to third-party apps.
sources.limitations: One thread and its replies; not representative, not a verified measure of demand, no user identifiers retained.

sources.source: r/Instagram public discussion of Instagram data exports
sources.summary: A poster discusses export format choices, JSON detail, and archive size when media is included.
sources.limitations: Single self-reported experience; format advice is not official platform documentation.
